name: Clairic (preview)
notes: Run by the maintainers through the Workers AI REST API with default options, one request at a time from Europe, so latency includes the network round trip. Answers are scored as returned; list answers are not filtered by their confidence.

name: Turion Extract alpha
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
notes: Gemma 4 12B with a LoRA adapter and extraction heads: one forward pass, no generated tokens. Trained on the training splits of SQuAD 2.0, CUAD, CORD, DROP, TAT-QA and Few-NERD (the index scores their validation and test splits) and on synthetic documents from Turion AI's own generator, written without the index's docs generator, so docs is the only test outside its training domains. Run by Turion AI, one request at a time in BF16; latency is the local forward pass, with no network.

name: Null baseline
notes: Answers null for every field. This is the floor: each test scores its share of fields whose gold is null.
